# Written from Microsoft's public notes on IMAP for Outlook.com, not recorded from a real account.
# No MOVE and no CONDSTORE: a client has to COPY, flag \Deleted and EXPUNGE, and rescan flags by UID.
S: * OK The Microsoft Exchange IMAP4 service is ready.
C: <tag> LOGIN "user@outlook.example" "app password"
S: <tag> OK LOGIN completed.
C: <tag> SELECT INBOX
S: * 3 EXISTS
S: * 0 RECENT
S: * OK [UNSEEN 1] Message 1 is first unseen
S: * OK [UIDVALIDITY 14] UIDVALIDITY value
S: * OK [UIDNEXT 40] The next unique identifier value
S: * FLAGS (\Seen \Answered \Flagged \Deleted \Draft $MDNSent)
S: <tag> OK [READ-WRITE] SELECT completed.
C: <tag> UID COPY 38 Archive
S: <tag> OK [COPYUID 22 38 7] COPY completed.
C: <tag> UID STORE 38 +FLAGS.SILENT (\Deleted)
S: <tag> OK STORE completed.
C: <tag> UID EXPUNGE 38
S: * 3 EXPUNGE
S: <tag> OK UID EXPUNGE completed.
